title: Rellenitos de Plátano
description: Rellenitos de Plátano is a dish from Guatemala prepared with plantain, canned black beans. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 25 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 8 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Prepare the filling ingredients: cook or soften any components that require it, let cool, then mix into an even filling.
Shape, press or roll the prepared dough or mixture into portions appropriate to this dish.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 14 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
